name: cwb-ship
description: Scaffold production-ready React Native apps from Code with Beto templates using the @codewithbeto/ship CLI.

interface.longDescription: One-command project scaffolding with bunx @codewithbeto/ship. Ships the battle-tested Platano template with pre-configured RevenueCat payments, automatic app name, bundle ID and slug configuration, dependency installation, and git initialization out of the box.
